author: FEL (MUSIC-SUITE P9, 2026-09-29)
about: Difficulty 3. Accents follow the whistle lead (1.5, 2, 3.5) and the kick and clap in the verses (2.5 / 3 as an eighth double inside the six-step); each break bar is a freeze; free-tap bars every two beats, one bar-pair every beat in the last hook; the outro breathes out to its last spin. The second hook opens on the captured KICK STEP (CMU 85_14). The last hook ends in a FREESTYLE section (fs2: the same free taps, marked) — and, since 2026-10-17, so does the first (the same marked phrase in place of its last free phrase: the same slots, so the steps, the STYLE taps, the cap and a flawless score are unchanged): the buttons pick the move, MATCH is not asked, and it pays STYLE only. Accents, doubles and free taps are STYLE taps; only the moves are scored steps. CAPTURED MOVES (owner 2026-10-17, lane/dance-options): the kick step is spelled as the capture's id — the same families, beats and accents, so the scored steps, the cap and a flawless NORMAL score are unchanged (HARD's fill moves where a move's length changed). sidefreeze stays the baby freeze: the charts are written around its 2-beat hold.
